description: Returns a normalized availability handoff for a source-linked independent Orange County, CA car-rental provider, including availability class live, booking-site, or none; it does not guarantee inventory. Use when: the user has selected a provider and wants the provider handoff to check availability for specific pickup and return dates and, optionally, a vehicle type. Do not use when: the user needs guaranteed real-time inventory or price, national chains or franchises, a category outside car rentals, payment, or a completed reservation; availability only returns a class and provider handoff.

business_id.description: Required stable business ID returned by search.

pickup_date.description: Required pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

return_date.description: Required return date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vehicle_type.description: Optional requested vehicle type or class, such as SUV or exotic.

name: availability
